Rather than ship a traditional public REST API, Freed pursues an "anti-integration" model in which a Chrome-extension AI agent navigates any web-based EHR (Athena, Tebra, PracticeFusion, TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, Elation, AdvancedMD, Cerbo, and others) to place the finished note in the correct fields. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: Tia Health
providers.description: Tia Health is a Canadian telehealth platform that connects patients with licensed Canadian providers - family doctors, nurse practitioners, specialists, and naturopaths - for on-demand virtual care by phone, video, and secure messaging. Its services span virtual walk-in and family-practice appointments, prescription renewals, sick notes, lab requisitions, and mental health therapy (via partner Focus Mental Wellness), with visits covered by provincial health plans in Ontario (OHIP), British Columbia (MSP), and Alberta (AHCIP) and paid options elsewhere. Tia Health is part of the WELL Health Technologies Corp. clinic network, one of the largest outpatient networks in Canada. As of this review Tia Health is a consumer-facing virtual-care product with no public developer portal, no documented REST/OpenAPI, and no exposed HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement or SMART-on-FHIR configuration; interoperability in the Canadian market is stewarded federally through Canada Health Infoway's pan-Canadian FHIR (CA Core / CA Baseline) specifications, which this platform does not publicly surface.

providers.name: Womaness
providers.description: Womaness is a women-founded midlife wellness brand created to modernize aging for women and to help them navigate the phases their bodies move through around menopause. The direct-to-consumer company sells clean, estrogen-free, doctor-approved and clinically tested skincare, supplements, sexual-health and menopause-support products (including Let's Neck serum, Melt for You inserts and Daily V Soothe) through a Shopify-hosted online store and select retail partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API surface.

providers.name: Axxess
providers.description: Home health, hospice, and private duty software with REST APIs for managing patient plans of care, visit documentation, billing, scheduling, and OASIS assessments. Axxess provides certified EHR technology with FHIR-compliant interoperability, supporting data exchange across care settings via HL7, TEFCA, FHIR, HITRUST, and HIPAA standards.

providers.name: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services
providers.description: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services, now operating as CPS Solutions, LLC, is a healthcare company with more than 50 years of experience providing pharmacy and hospital solutions across the care continuum. It serves independent hospitals, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), and specialized health facilities with specialty pharmacy, pharmacy management, telepharmacy (24/7/365 support), 340B program compliance, supply chain management, rehabilitation services, and consulting. The company operates two proprietary SaaS platforms — CPS Optimizer for pharmacy management and TherigySTM for specialty pharmacy management — supported by 2,500+ healthcare professionals serving 800+ customers across the United States and Puerto Rico. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Digbi Health
providers.description: Digbi Health is a digital therapeutics company delivering a precision-biology virtual clinic for food-related and inflammatory illnesses — obesity, cardiometabolic disease, type 2 diabetes, digestive disorders (IBS, GERD), MSK chronic pain, PCOS, sleep and mental health. Its FoodRx program combines host-genetics and gut-microbiome testing with app-based coaching, precision nutrition, and pre/probiotic therapies, delivered to members through health plans and employers. Digbi Health is backed by Accel. The company operates a consumer-facing storefront and member app rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the public web, agent, and security surfaces observable at digbihealth.com.

providers.name: YAZIO
providers.description: YAZIO GmbH is an Erfurt, Germany based digital health company whose nutrition app pairs calorie and macro tracking with barcode scanning, AI photo food logging, an intermittent-fasting timer, a 3,000-recipe library and body-metric tracking across iOS, Android and the web. The company describes itself as remote-first, cites more than 100 million downloads across over 150 countries, and sells a freemium product: a free tier plus a "YAZIO PRO" subscription transacted through the Apple App Store and Google Play rather than through a pricing page on yazio.com. YAZIO publishes no developer program of any kind — no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract, no SDKs, no CLI, no MCP server, no changelog, no status page and no security.txt. Its apps talk to a private backend at https://yzapi.yazio.com, which is live but answers 401 with an empty body to anonymous requests and issues OAuth client credentials through no public process. Every YAZIO OpenAPI description, client library and MCP server in circulation is third-party reverse-engineering that states in its own README that it is unofficial and unaffiliated.

providers.name: Activ Surgical
providers.description: Activ Surgical is a Boston, Massachusetts digital surgery company building intraoperative surgical intelligence for the operating room. Its flagship product, the ActivSight Intelligent Light imaging module, attaches to existing laparoscopic and robotic surgical systems and renders augmented-reality overlays on a standard monitor, letting surgeons see physiology the naked eye cannot. ActivPerfusion delivers dye-free, real-time blood-perfusion imaging using laser speckle contrast imaging, while ActivICG supports conventional indocyanine green visualization of structures such as bile ducts. The module is powered by the ActivEdge platform, a hardware-agnostic computer-vision, AI and machine-learning stack the company is building to turn intraoperative data into real-time surgical guidance. Activ Surgical performed the first autonomous robotic soft-tissue surgery in 2018, received FDA 510(k) clearance for ActivSight in April 2021 and CE Mark approval in December 2022, and sells on a subscription model with no capital-equipment purchase. The company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract as of this profiling pass; its public technical surface is regulatory (EU MDR declarations of conformity, ISO 13485:2016) and clinical (peer-reviewed studies and white papers).

providers.name: Better Life Partners
providers.description: Better Life Partners is a Hanover, New Hampshire healthcare provider founded in 2018 that delivers same-day, whole-person treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorder across New Hampshire, Maine, Massachusetts, Vermont and North Carolina. It combines FDA-approved medication for addiction treatment (buprenorphine/Suboxone, naltrexone) with group counseling, peer recovery coaching and mental health care, delivered both virtually and in person, on a non-punitive harm-reduction model. The company contracts directly with Medicaid, Medicare and commercial health plans — MaineCare, NH Healthy Families, Anthem, Cigna, Harvard Pilgrim, Tufts, Humana and UnitedHealthcare — and markets value-based arrangements "from bundles to full risk" to payers and community partners. It is a clinical services organization rather than a software vendor: it references "purpose-built technology" internally but publishes no developer program, API, specification, SDK or integration documentation of any kind.

providers.name: Caresyntax
providers.description: Caresyntax is a surgical intelligence company that builds a vendor-neutral, enterprise-scale data platform for the operating room. Founded in 2013 in Berlin and now dual-headquartered in Berlin and San Francisco, it captures video, audio, image, device, EMR, financial and outcomes data from inside and around the OR and applies AI analytics to it — delivering pre-operative workflow optimization, real-time intraoperative decision support, and post-operative clinical safety, quality and utilization insights. The platform pairs the PRIME365 vendor-neutral OR / medical-device integration layer with the qvident surgical performance-management and analytics suite, and is deployed in more than 4,000 operating rooms worldwide. Caresyntax sells to hospitals and surgery centers, MedTech manufacturers and insurers, and integrates with EMR, PACS and scheduling systems. It operates an API gateway at api.caresyntax.com, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract — integration is delivered through enterprise and partner engagements.

providers.name: Francis Medical
providers.description: Francis Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota, founded in 2018 by Michael Hoey and named for his father, who died of prostate cancer in 1991. It develops the Vanquish Water Vapor Ablation System, a transurethral outpatient platform that ablates targeted prostate tissue using the thermal energy stored in sterile water vapor delivered in short bursts through a catheter, with the aim of treating localized disease while avoiding the incontinence and sexual dysfunction associated with radical prostatectomy and radiation. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2023 and 510(k) clearance for prostate tissue ablation in December 2025, and it is running the VAPOR 1 and VAPOR 2 clinical studies alongside a long-term registry; it has signalled intent to extend the same water vapor platform to bladder and kidney cancer. Francis Medical has raised roughly $160 million to date, including an $80 million Series C in January 2025 co-led by Solas BioVentures and Arboretum Ventures, with earlier participation from Coloplast. It is led by president and CEO Mike Kujak. Francis Medical publishes a physician locator, an electronic instructions-for-use (eIFU) library and a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy for its devices and embedded software, but operates no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Offcall
providers.description: Offcall is a career and practice platform for physicians, backed by Bloomberg Beta. It provides confidential, anonymous physician salary and compensation benchmarking, and a verified clinician-to-clinician patient referrals network with HIPAA-compliant messaging for care coordination, delivered through web and mobile (iOS and Android) applications. Offcall does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this profile was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Oscar
providers.description: Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR) is a technology-driven health insurance company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City. It offers individual and family health plans, small-business and ICHRA employer benefits, and Medicare Advantage in a growing set of U.S. states, pairing coverage with a consumer mobile app, 24/7 virtual urgent care, telemedicine, primary care, and concierge Care Teams. Oscar's +Oscar division licenses its full-stack technology platform (Campaign Builder and other tools) to other payers and providers. The company is NCQA-accredited across Health Plan, Utilization Management, Credentialing, Provider Network, and Health Equity programs. Oscar is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As a CMS-regulated payer it is subject to the Interoperability and Patient Access rule, though it does not currently publish an open, self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Seed Health
providers.description: Seed Health is a microbiome science company founded in 2017 by Ara Katz and Raja Dhir, headquartered in Los Angeles County, California. It develops and sells clinically studied probiotic, prebiotic and synbiotic consumer products — most notably the DS-01 Daily Synbiotic, the PDS-08 Pediatric Daily Synbiotic and the VS-01 Vaginal Synbiotic — direct to consumers via a subscription commerce site at seed.com, alongside SeedLabs, its environmental and applied-microbiology research arm. Seed publishes a substantial public science, editorial (Cultured) and help-center surface, and maintains a small public GitHub organization, but it operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no published API reference, no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI or MCP contract, and its internal storefront API paths are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt. Its practitioner program is fulfilled through Fullscript and email rather than through any integration surface.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Artera Decisionrisk Analysis
providers.description: Artera Decisionrisk Analysis, operating as ArteraAI, provides personalized precision medicine and AI-driven cancer therapy solutions. The company offers a multimodal AI platform for clinicians and patients, including diagnostic tests for prostate and breast cancer, and supports HIPAA-compliant data handling. Artera aims to improve outcomes through advanced analytics and regulatory‑approved medical software.

providers.name: Blocks
providers.description: Blocks is an AI‑native training platform for endurance athletes. It lets you build and visualise structured intervals, sync every ride, and train with an assistant that reads your real data – cycling, running, swimming and strength. The service offers a free tier and premium plans, integrates with Strava and intervals.icu, and provides an MCP server for Claude and other AI agents.

providers.name: Calo
providers.description: Calo is a food-tech company founded in Bahrain in 2019 that operates a personalized meal-subscription and delivery service. Nutritionist-designed, chef-prepared meals are portioned to each customer's health goals and lifestyle, with 80+ new meal options rotated weekly and flexible pause/cancel anytime. Built by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers around proprietary nutritional algorithms, Calo has expanded to seven markets across the GCC and beyond (Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman), ordered through its consumer apps. Calo is backed by 500 Global. It is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API or documented client SDKs.

providers.name: Fortell
providers.description: Fortell develops clinically proven AI hearing aids that provide superior speech clarity in noisy environments. The company leverages advanced AI algorithms and scientific research to enhance hearing experiences for users, offering personalized solutions and a modern approach to auditory health.

providers.name: Tigerconnect
providers.description: TigerConnect is a healthcare clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platform used by 7,000+ healthcare organizations to unify secure messaging, clinical collaboration, alarm management, physician and nurse scheduling, patient engagement, nurse call, and pre-hospital care-team coordination on one activation layer. It integrates with 200+ medical devices and EHR systems and adds an AI orchestration engine (CareConduit) that routes alerts and workflows to the right clinical role at the right time. TigerConnect is recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Clinical Communications and Collaboration. The company publishes end-user product release notes, an SLA, and legal terms, but exposes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Visby Medical
providers.description: Visby Medical is a molecular diagnostics company that has miniaturized the gold-standard PCR laboratory onto a single-use, palm-sized point-of-care device, delivering lab-quality results in about 30 minutes without any instrument, sample transport, or lab infrastructure. Its consumer offering (sold direct at visby.com) is an FDA-authorized at-home women's sexual health test that detects Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, and Trichomoniasis, paired with same-day telehealth consultation on a positive result. Visby also builds point-of-care PCR platforms for clinical and respiratory pathogen testing. The company is backed by venture investors including Amplify Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks Visby Medical as a company; the business is a hardware diagnostics and direct-to-consumer commerce operation and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: WeiMai
providers.description: WeiMai (微脉) is a Chinese healthcare technology company operated by Choice Technology Inc. and headquartered in Hangzhou. It runs an internet-based medical services marketplace and licensed internet hospitals (including Hainan WeiMai Internet Hospital) that connect patients with doctors for online consultation, pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and health-management service packages, delivered primarily through the WeiMai consumer mobile app. WeiMai also operates a partner-facing Open Platform (微脉开发平台) at openapi.myweimai.com that exposes a Swagger 2.0 API surface for approved integrators; the public specification is a minimal stub with no operations exposed without partner credentials. The company is backed by IDG Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio company.

providers.name: Catalina Crunch
providers.description: Catalina Crunch creates high‑protein, low‑sugar snacks and cereals, founded by a Type 1 diabetic to fill a market gap for nutritious, low‑sugar options. The brand now offers a broad portfolio of snacks, cereals, granola, and chocolate bars, emphasizing protein and fiber while minimizing sugar, and provides online shopping, subscriptions, and retail locations across the US.

providers.name: Fidocure
providers.description: FidoCure is a translational precision-medicine service for canine cancer, developed by One Health Company and backed by a16z. It combines next-generation genomic sequencing of a dog's tumor at a CLIA-certified (human-grade) lab with tumor profiling and an AI-driven data platform to identify cancer-driving mutations, then recommends personalized targeted therapeutics that veterinarians can prescribe. FidoCure has guided treatment for thousands of dogs across roughly 1,350 clinics and maintains the largest proprietary canine cancer dataset, underpinning peer-reviewed research with Stanford, the Broad Institute, Tufts, and the University of Georgia. FidoCure operates as a veterinarian-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, portal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Five Lives
providers.description: Five Lives is a health-technology company building evidence-based digital tools for dementia prevention and brain health for adults aged 50 and over. Founded by former Peak brain-training leaders Xavier Louis (CEO) and Sylvain Piquet (COO), the fully remote company operates two consumer mobile apps: Five Lives Brain Health, a prevention app available since 2021 with cognitive tests, brain games, and lifestyle tracking across five pillars (nutrition, sleep, physical activity, mood and social connection, and mental stimulation); and Five Lives Care, an evidence-based memory and autonomy programme for people aged 60+ launched in January 2026 and developed with leading memory centres in the UK and France. Its work draws on the FINGER study and the Lancet Commission's modifiable dementia risk factors, with research partners including the University of Oxford, Trinity College Dublin, the FINGER Brain Health Institute, Dementias Platform UK, and the Gerontopole d'Ile de France. Backed by Speedinvest. Five Lives does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: InFact
providers.description: InFact (InFact UK Ltd, trading as Infact — Solutions in public health) builds software for communicable-disease control and public-health service delivery. Founded in 2003 by Dr Chakib Kara-Zaitri and Bob Hamilton, the company's flagship product HPZone is an integrated suite for infectious-disease control built on two decades of frontline work with the national health services of the United Kingdom and the Netherlands: HPCore for case, contact and outbreak management with decision-support protocols and enquiry handling, EpiQ for epidemiological questionnaires, and HPInsight for surveillance dashboards, reporting and modelling. A second product line, Ampara (the successor to SHDirect), covers the clinic patient journey from triage through consultation, diagnostics, prescribing and follow-up. InFact is a Silver Industry Partner of openEHR International. HPZone exposes a credential-gated GraphQL API over cases, contacts, situations, enquiries, actions and contexts; the API exists and is in production use by national public-health bodies, but InFact publishes no public developer portal, reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: May
providers.description: May is a French digital-health company, operated by LN CARE SAS, whose mobile app supports future and new parents from fertility and pregnancy through the first years of a child's life. It pairs a medical messaging service staffed by French-qualified midwives, pediatric nurses and doctors — answering questions seven days a week from 8am to 10pm — with an expert-reviewed content library, roughly hour-long audio masterclasses, everyday tracking tools for sleep, feeding and weight, and Mya, an in-app AI medical assistant. Founded in Paris in 2020 by Cécilia Creuzet, Antoine Creuzet and Adrien Brunet, it reported more than 400,000 users and a team of around 80 health professionals, raised €7M in September 2024 to expand into Spain and the United Kingdom, and also sells a parental-support benefit to employers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Serena and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog and an Intercom help center, but no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: SAVA
providers.description: SAVA (sava.health) is a health-monitoring company developing a minimally invasive, continuous multi-molecule biosensor worn just beneath the skin. The platform is designed to capture real-time molecular data - glucose, lactate, ketones, sodium, histamine, urea, alcohol, and cortisol - and surface it through a connected mobile app, aiming to shift healthcare toward preventative monitoring and personal wellness. The company is early stage and pre-launch, operating a waiting-list model for early access to its device rather than a public product. It publishes no first-party developer API or health-data API; its marketing site is built on Wix and exposes the Wix Site MCP endpoint and a published llms.txt for agentic access to public site content only. Backed by Balderton Capital.

providers.name: Virgin Pulse
providers.description: Virgin Pulse is a corporate health and employee wellbeing platform that in 2024 merged with HealthComp and rebranded as Personify Health, operating today at personifyhealth.com. The company delivers a personalized health platform that unites wellbeing, healthcare navigation and advocacy, benefits administration, third-party administration (TPA), and rewards into a single employee experience for enterprises, health plans, and health systems. Integration with Personify Health is handled through an authentication-gated developer portal (developer.personifyhealth.com) and a partner marketplace (marketplace.personifyhealth.com); there is no publicly documented, open API specification. This profile was seeded as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched from the company's live public surface (llms.txt, status page, developer portal, and DNS/TLS probes).

providers.name: Agebold
providers.description: Agebold, which operates as Bold, is a digital healthy-aging platform for adults 65 and older, delivered as a covered benefit through Medicare Advantage plans and other Medicare organizations. Bold offers personalized, science-backed exercise programs shown to reduce fall risk, ease musculoskeletal pain, and increase physical activity, alongside nutrition and weight-loss support (including GLP-1 care), live classes, expert talks, and virtual access to doctors, therapists, and nurse practitioners in select states. The company partners with health plans to improve quality measures, Star Ratings, HOS performance, and total cost of care. Agebold is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Air Doctor
providers.description: Air Doctor is a digital health platform that connects travelers and people living abroad with a global network of vetted private doctors and specialists, offering in-person clinic visits, home visits, and telemedicine appointments in multiple languages across more than 75 countries. Users search for and book local doctors through the Air Doctor mobile app and web app, and the company operates a large B2B business embedding its provider network into travel insurance, assistance, and health-plan partners (including brands such as Allianz Global Assistance, ERGO, World Nomads, and Charles Taylor). Air Doctor is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, partner, and web surface; Air Doctor does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time, so this profile is maintained as an identity and web-property record.

providers.name: Angstrom Bio
providers.description: Angstrom Bio is a biotechnology company focused on machine intelligence for human health, leveraging amplicon sequencing and machine learning to develop diagnostic solutions. Their goal is to maximize the reach of amplicon sequencing diagnostics to save, prolong, and improve human lives. The company operates from 2020-2026 and provides research, news, and privacy policy information on their website. Angstrom Bio aims to revolutionize diagnostics by integrating advanced sequencing technologies with AI-driven analysis, delivering scalable, accurate, and affordable tests for a wide range of diseases, ultimately enhancing patient outcomes worldwide.

providers.name: Ash Wellness
providers.description: Ash Wellness provides at‑home health testing solutions for organizations, enabling health plans and public health entities to close care gaps with convenient, accurate diagnostics. Their platform offers a range of testing kits for infectious disease, cancer screening, chronic conditions, hormonal health, and environmental health, supported by a digital health integration and robust data reporting.

providers.name: BeMe Health
providers.description: BeMe Health, operating under the brand Hazel Health, provides K‑12 telehealth services, offering virtual mental and physical health care for students through school district partnerships. The company focuses on equitable access to pediatric care, integrating therapy, medical consultations, and wellness resources via its online platform.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: DeepScribe
providers.description: DeepScribe is a San Francisco, California ambient AI medical scribe company that automates clinical documentation and coding for specialty healthcare providers. Founded in 2017 (incorporated 2019) by Matthew Ko, Kairui Zeng, and Akilesh Bapu, DeepScribe captures the natural conversation between clinician and patient and produces structured clinical notes inside the provider's existing EHR workflow. The platform is HIPAA-compliant and is deployed across more than 1,500 healthcare organizations, with reported traction of 8 million+ visits captured and a 99.92% note-satisfaction rating. Core products include the AI Medical Scribe (ambient documentation), SmartPrep (pre-visit intelligence), AI Coding (E/M, ICD-10, and HCC automation), Customization Studio (provider-specific note personalization), and DeepScribe Assist (point-of-care insights). DeepScribe ships bi-directional EHR integrations with Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, AdvancedMD, drchrono, ModMed, Flatiron (OncoEMR), Ontada (iKnowMed Generation 2), and Objective Medical Systems, with a focused practice in oncology, cardiology, gastroenterology, neurology, orthopedics, urology, and value-based care. The company partners with AWS, Anthropic, Deloitte, and Panda Health for infrastructure, model, and go-to-market support. DeepScribe is sold as enterprise SaaS through a contact-sales motion; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and authentication into the clinician workspace happens through canvas.deepscribe.ai.

providers.name: Doctor on Demand
providers.description: Doctor on Demand is a telehealth platform offering 24/7 virtual medical care through video visits with board-certified clinicians. Services span urgent care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, primary care, and preventive health, with prescriptions routed to local pharmacies. Now part of Included Health, it serves consumers directly and through employer and health-plan benefit programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, GV, and Shasta Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Doctor on Demand publishes no public developer or partner API program; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Getteal
providers.description: Getteal (Teal Health) is a women's health company offering an FDA-authorized at-home cervical cancer screening kit, the Teal Wand, a self-collection device that lets people collect a sample privately at home and mail it to a laboratory for Primary HPV testing (the same cobas HPV test used in clinics). The service pairs the device with virtual provider consultations, a patient portal for results, insurance and HSA/FSA billing, and support for major U.S. health plans. Getteal is backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it is a consumer digital-health brand with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Hazel Health
providers.description: Hazel Health is the nation's leading provider of school-based telehealth, delivering virtual physical and mental health care to K-12 students. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hazel partners directly with school districts and families to connect students with licensed, linguistically and culturally diverse clinicians and therapists — at school or at home — often within minutes for medical care and within days for teletherapy, at no cost to families. The company serves more than two million students across 100-plus districts nationwide, helping reduce chronic absenteeism and address gaps in access to care as an extension of the school health team. Hazel operates HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant systems with full encryption and secure access controls. It is a B2B/B2G healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Ixlayer
providers.description: Ixlayer is a direct-to-patient healthcare technology company that helps biopharmaceutical companies transform the patient experience through an integrated, AI-enabled platform. Its unified platform spans virtual patient onboarding and intake, telehealth for primary and specialty care, at-home and in-center lab testing with mobile phlebotomy, prescription fulfillment (retail, specialty, and home delivery), benefits verification and claims, connected care with provider directories and scheduling, and the ixAI patient concierge for AI-powered support and care coordination. Ixlayer says it has powered more than 1,100 nationwide programs and enabled over 4 million patient care journeys, and states its services are SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. The company is backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Musely
providers.description: Musely is a telehealth platform, founded in 2012 by Jack Jia and Carrie Jiao and based in San Jose, California, that connects patients with U.S. board-certified dermatologists for personalized, prescription-strength skincare and related care. Patients share skin concerns online, physicians craft personalized treatment plans, and freshly compounded formulas are shipped to the patient. Since pivoting from a wellness community to prescription skincare in 2019, Musely has expanded into hair loss, hormonal/menopause health, and longevity, serving more than 1.2 million patients. Musely is a consumer/health company in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a direct-to-consumer web and mobile telehealth experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Revel Ai Health
providers.description: RevelAi Health is a healthcare technology company building a conversational AI platform for orthopedic and musculoskeletal care teams. Its AI agent, "kimi," automates patient outreach, triage, clinical documentation, and follow-up across the care episode, supporting value-based care models, quality reporting, and Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROM) collection. The platform offers multilingual population-health outreach across voice, text, and email, ambient clinical documentation, and AI-augmented staffing and task management for ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals and health systems, and physician practices. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and maintains SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance programs. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: SteadyMD
providers.description: SteadyMD is a telehealth infrastructure and clinical-workforce company (a DocGo company) backed by Lux Capital. It supplies board-certified physicians and nurse practitioners, clinical operations, and 50-state licensing and credentialing, plus technology and telehealth APIs that let healthcare and digital-health partners launch branded, fully managed virtual care. Its APIs cover patient data submission, synchronous and asynchronous consult requests, two-way patient-clinician messaging, intake forms, clinician availability, real-time status updates, document attachments, scheduling, and reporting/SLA retrieval, offered as either a Limited (partner-EMR) or Complete (SteadyMD-EMR) integration. API documentation is provided under a business agreement via a request form; there is no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Sunnyside
providers.description: Sunnyside is a digital health platform for alcohol moderation, founded in 2020, that helps members cut back on or quit drinking through personalized weekly plans, drink tracking and analytics, human text-based coaching, habit-building exercises, and a supportive community. Its separate Sunnyside Med telehealth service connects members with licensed providers who can prescribe compounded naltrexone. Sunnyside is a consumer mobile app and telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Tend
providers.description: Tend (Tend Dental) is a consumer dental-care company offering modern, judgment-free dentistry through a network of design-forward "studios" across New York City, Boston, Atlanta, Washington DC, Nashville and Connecticut. The brand pairs a soothing in-person studio experience and top-rated dentists with a fully online booking and patient-intake flow at hellotend.com. Services span preventive hygiene, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, veneers, Invisalign and clear aligners, orthodontics, dental implants, endodontics, sedation and emergency care. Backed by GV and Redpoint Ventures. This is a consumer web/ booking business with no public developer API surface; the profile is enriched with identity, security-posture and discovery-probe artifacts only.

providers.name: Tennr
providers.description: Tennr is a New York City-based healthcare technology company (founded 2021) building agentic patient-orchestration software that automates referral-based care operations for providers and health systems. Its proprietary vision-language model, RaeLM, is trained on over 100 million anonymized medical documents to read faxes, referrals, and unstructured records, then automates document classification, data extraction, patient qualification, insurance eligibility verification, and prior-authorization submission by integrating directly with existing EHR systems. Tennr processes over 10 million documents monthly and is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant. It raised a $101M Series C at a $605M valuation led by IVP, with a16z, Lightspeed, GV, ICONIQ, and Foundation Capital participating. Tennr does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or specification; integrations are delivered through EHR connections and professional services.

providers.name: WOO Sports
providers.description: WOO Sports makes a sensor-based performance-tracking system for kitesurfing, wingfoiling, and windsurfing. The WOO 4.0 device mounts to a board and measures jump height, airtime, G-force, and landing impact, syncing sessions through the WOO Sports mobile apps (iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, and Garmin) to a global community platform with leaderboards, spots, activity feeds, and events. More than 100,000 riders use WOO to track sessions and compete, including on the GKA Kite World Tour. WOO Sports is a Techstars-backed brand operated under Boards & More. This profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; no public developer API was found (docs.woosports.com is a consumer user guide, not an API reference).

providers.name: ZOE
providers.description: ZOE (joinzoe.com, canonically zoe.com) is a personalized nutrition and health science company founded on data from one of the largest nutrition research studies in the world. Its membership program pairs at-home testing (gut health, blood sugar, and blood fat responses) with an AI-powered app that scores meals, tracks personal food responses, and delivers science-backed dietary guidance. ZOE also sells consumer products including the Daily30+ whole-food supplement and Gut Health products, and publishes the ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer health brand rather than an API provider, and is tracked here as a Balderton Capital portfolio company; it currently exposes no public developer platform, API, or developer portal.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Capim
providers.description: Capim is a Sao Paulo-based vertical SaaS and fintech company for the dental sector in Brazil, founded in 2021 by Marcelo Lutz and Roberto Biselli. Its platform pairs dental-clinic management software - appointment scheduling (Agenda Capim), digital patient records, and AI-driven patient reactivation - with embedded financial products: buy-now-pay-later patient financing (Financiamento Capim, up to 36 installments), direct-credit collections (Carne Capim), and an integrated card/PIX payment terminal (Maquininha Capim). Capim serves more than 6,000 dental clinics, has issued over R$450 million in credit, and raised a US$26.7M Series A co-led by Valor Capital and QED Investors. No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Circle Medical
providers.description: Circle Medical is a San Francisco-based online and in-person primary care clinic offering telemedicine and clinic-based visits with same and next-day availability. Founded through Y Combinator, the company operates 20+ physical locations and provides virtual appointments across multiple US states through Circle Medical Care of California, an independent medical practice. Its 400+ board-certified physicians, physician assistants, and nurse practitioners treat primary care, mental health (ADHD, anxiety, depression), hormone and sexual health, urgent care, weight loss (GLP-1s), sleep, and dermatology. Circle Medical is a HIPAA-covered, patient-facing digital health provider; it publishes no public developer API or SDK program, and this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dentrix
providers.description: Dentrix is a dental practice management platform from Henry Schein One, used by dental offices to manage patients, scheduling, clinical charting, treatment planning, insurance, and billing. Dentrix exposes third-party integration APIs through two distinct channels. The original Dentrix Developer Program (DDP, launched 2012) targets the on-premise Dentrix desktop application: integrations run locally against the office's Dentrix database over password-protected ODBC connections, stored procedures, table views, and DLL functions (authenticated via a RegisterUser call) - it is NOT a public REST/cloud API, and cloud integrations require a locally installed desktop agent. The newer Dentrix Ascend API Exchange (launched July 2023) is a cloud, REST/JSON API over HTTPS secured with OAuth 2.0 on the SOC 2 Type II Dentrix Ascend platform, exposing patient, scheduling, claims, and inventory data. Both channels are partner-gated: access requires an application, a signed agreement, and paid developer fees. There is no public self-serve API key or published OpenAPI, so the APIs below are modeled from Henry Schein One's public developer materials rather than an official machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Galileo
providers.description: Galileo (galileo.io, formerly reached at galileohealth.com) is a value-based, digitally enabled healthcare delivery company founded by Tom X. Lee (previously Epocrates and One Medical). It delivers 24/7 primary and multi-specialty care through a mobile app, in-home visits, mobile clinics, and virtual care, combining a proprietary clinical technology platform, a recruited network of primary-care and specialist clinicians, and hospitality-style member support. Galileo operates a fully bilingual (English/Spanish) platform and serves individuals and families, employers, small businesses, and health plans through membership and population- health partnerships. It is a care-delivery business, not an API platform: as of this profile Galileo publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Nitra
providers.description: Nitra is an integrated financial and operational platform — an "operating system" — for independent medical practices, unifying business banking, spend management, payments, accounting, capital, and front-desk automation in one system. Its core products include the Nitra Card (a Visa business card with cashback and vendor pricing), NitraMart (a medical-supplies marketplace), BillPay payment processing, accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Nextech), Trina (an AI assistant for phone reception and invoice matching), and capital products such as lending, equipment financing, and insurance factoring. Nitra primarily serves eye care, aesthetics, dental specialty, and fertility practices as well as multi-site groups. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA-aware, holds funds at FDIC-insured banks, and is backed by a16z and Pantera Capital. Nitra publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Thyrocare
providers.description: Thyrocare Technologies Limited is an Indian chain of diagnostic and preventive-care laboratories headquartered in Navi Mumbai, founded in 1996. Built around a centralized, highly automated laboratory model, it focuses on affordable preventive health checkups, thyroid and pathology testing, and sells through a nationwide network of DSA (Direct Selling Agent) franchise partners. Norwest Venture Partners invested pre-IPO, and PharmEasy (API Holdings) acquired a majority stake in 2021. Its partner order-booking API (TechSo/BTS) is gated behind the DSA program and publishes no public OpenAPI.

providers.name: Caresense
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Curve Dental
providers.description: Curve Dental is a cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia. Its flagship platform, Curve Hero, serves more than 80,000 dental professionals across the United States and Canada, unifying scheduling, clinical and perio charting, imaging, billing, insurance, smart forms, reporting, patient engagement, and business analytics in a single browser-based system. Curve is privately held and backed by Battery Ventures, and connects to a growing ecosystem of integration partners (including DentalXChange, DentalHQ, Pearl AI, Bola AI, and Mango Voice) rather than exposing a public self-serve developer API. This profile was seeded from Battery Ventures' portfolio and enriched from Curve Dental's public web surface; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Fertifa
providers.description: Fertifa is Europe's reproductive healthcare benefits provider for employers, giving companies a way to offer fertility, family-forming, women's health, maternity, menopause, men's reproductive health, and neurodiversity support to their employees. The platform pairs an in-house clinical team with education and training, diagnostics and testing, prescriptions and medication delivery, and financing/reimbursement, delivered to staff through a mobile app and to HR teams through enterprise and SME plans. Fertifa is London-based, backed by Speedinvest, and works with employers including Lululemon, Meta, Bain Capital, and Virgin. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: Flatiron Health
providers.description: Flatiron Health is a healthcare technology company focused on oncology, combining real-world data from millions of cancer patients with software and AI to support life sciences research and clinical care. Its platforms include OncoEMR and OncoCloud for oncology practices, Flatiron Vessel (clinical research EDC, formerly Protocol First) and Clinical Pipe for clinical trials, and real-world evidence products for life sciences. Flatiron data has informed thousands of peer-reviewed publications and regulatory submissions. The company is part of Roche.

providers.name: Joyful
providers.description: Joyful Health provides AI-assisted revenue recovery for healthcare organizations, combining automated claim investigation with expert billing teams to recover unpaid and denied insurance claims. Its platform runs inside an organization's existing revenue-cycle-management (RCM) systems rather than replacing them, covering denial investigation and root-cause analysis, claims recovery and appeals management, historical accounts-receivable (A/R) assessment, payer follow-up, documentation review, and financial insight to prevent future denials. The company operates a customer application at app.joyfulhealth.io and maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center. Joyful is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; Joyful does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Moneta Health
providers.description: Moneta Health provides an at‑home memory rehabilitation program delivered via phone and video. It offers personalized cognitive therapy to improve memory, focus, and daily functioning for patients with mild cognitive impairment. Backed by True Ventures, the service is covered by insurance in several U.S. states and aims to make brain health care accessible remotely.

providers.name: SuppCo
providers.description: SuppCo is a consumer supplement tracking and optimization platform, describing itself as the world's first real supplement tracker and optimizer. Its iOS and Android app lets people log their supplement stack and get a personalized StackScore across quality, dosing, goal coverage, and nutrient levels, plus a TrustScore that rates products on 29 attributes. It is backed by a database of 160,000+ products, 20,000+ research studies, and 80+ expert protocols from functional-medicine practitioners. SuppCo is in open beta (free, with an optional Pro tier) and was acquired by Function Health. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures its public web, security, and legal surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Tabz
providers.description: Tabz is a pharmacy commerce platform that provides payments, checkout, and invoicing solutions for manufacturers, mail‑order, compounding, specialty, and retail pharmacies. It enables seamless patient payment collection, integrates with pharmacy management systems, and offers APIs for building custom commerce experiences. Tabz aims to simplify the complex pharmacy payment ecosystem, supporting high‑cost medication workflows and improving checkout efficiency across the industry.

providers.name: Adagio Medical
providers.description: Adagio Medical, Inc. is a Laguna Hills, California medical device company and an operating subsidiary of Adagio Medical Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADGM). It develops catheter-based cardiac ablation systems built on its proprietary Ultra-Low Temperature Cryoablation (ULTC) platform and an emerging Pulsed Field Cryoablation (PFCA) platform, designed to create large, durable, transmural lesions for the treatment of ventricular tachycardia, atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter. Its CE-marked vCLAS Cryoablation System holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and is under U.S. evaluation in the FULCRUM-VT pivotal IDE study. Adagio Medical sells regulated physical devices to hospitals and electrophysiology labs; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract. It does publish a coordinated product-security vulnerability disclosure policy.

providers.name: Casana
providers.description: Casana (Casana Care) is a Rochester, New York digital-health company building passive, in-home remote patient monitoring hardware. Its flagship Smart Seat (formerly the Heart Seat) is a toilet-seat replacement that captures vital signs — heart rate, heart-rate variability, blood-oxygen (SpO2), respiration rate, blood-pressure insights, and sit-to-stand power — during normal bathroom use, with no wearables, no daily charging, and explicitly no camera or microphone. Readings sync to companion iOS, Android, and web apps for patients, families, and caregivers. The company operates in the digital health, remote patient monitoring, and connected medical-device space and is backed by General Catalyst and Kaiser Permanente. As of this profile Casana publishes a consumer product, companion apps, and legal/privacy pages, but no public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Foodvisor
providers.description: Foodvisor is a French mobile nutrition platform whose app identifies food items from a photograph using computer vision and returns nutritional information — calories, macronutrients and portion estimates. Between 2023 and 2025 Foodvisor also sold that capability to developers as the Foodvisor Vision API, a commercial image-recognition and nutrition-analysis service documented at vision.foodvisor.io. That developer product has since been withdrawn: the Vision product page now returns HTTP 404, the documentation host no longer resolves in DNS, and the live site carries no API, developer or enterprise content. Foodvisor today publishes no machine-readable contract, no SDK, no MCP server and no /.well-known document, and operates as a consumer subscription app.

providers.name: Labcorp
providers.description: Labcorp helps patients, providers, organizations, and biopharma companies guide vital healthcare decisions every day. Labcorp supports HL7 / FHIR-based integration for laboratory orders and results exchange with electronic health record (EHR) systems, but does not publish a fully open public developer portal; access is granted through health-system and biopharma integration agreements.

providers.name: Lenus eHealth
providers.description: Lenus eHealth is a Copenhagen-headquartered health and fitness technology company that builds a coaching platform for online health and fitness coaches, positioning itself as a growth partner rather than a consumer fitness app. Coaching partners run their businesses through the Lenus web dashboard and branded consumer mobile apps: client onboarding and screening, training and nutrition programming, habit and progress tracking, in-app messaging, content delivery, subscription billing and business analytics. The company also operates Lenus Academy, a certified education program for online coaches, and in the United States offers a GLP-1 weight management program delivered with independent medical partner Beluga Health. Lenus operates from 20+ offices including Copenhagen, Berlin, London, Amsterdam, Stockholm, Madrid, New York and Toronto, and is backed by EQT Ventures. The platform is closed and invitation-based: as of July 2026 Lenus publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications, and access is available only to coaching partners under a partnership agreement.

providers.name: Lucem Health
providers.description: Lucem Health is a clinical-AI company founded in 2021 with Mayo Clinic Platform, backed by Mayo Clinic, Commure and Rally Ventures. Its Lucem Health Reveal programs apply clinically validated AI models to a health system's existing data to surface patients at elevated risk of serious or chronic disease — arrhythmias, colorectal cancer, liver disease, lung cancer and Type 1 diabetes — and deliver those insights into existing clinical workflows without changing how clinicians practice. The company also runs a Clinical AI SolutionOps practice that helps AI innovators and life-sciences organizations deploy, scale and commercialize models against provider data. Integration is delivered as a managed service into EHR, PACS and other clinical systems; as of 2026-08-25 Lucem Health publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: MicroTech Medical
providers.description: MicroTech Medical (Hangzhou) develops user-friendly diabetes glucose monitoring devices — blood glucose monitoring systems (BGMS), the AiDEX continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system, the Equil patch insulin pump, a closed-loop artificial pancreas, point-of-care testing (POCT), and LinX. Its AiDEX API Platform (aidexapi.microtechmd.com) is a self-service developer portal that registers developers and issues API credentials for accessing blood glucose data resources from AiDEX CGM devices, with separate global and China regional endpoints. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: WellTheory
providers.description: WellTheory is a virtual autoimmune care platform that provides whole-person support for people living with autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, pairing members with a dedicated care team for nutrition, lifestyle, and clinical guidance across more than 100 conditions. The company sells to employers and health plans as a covered benefit as well as direct to consumers, and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. WellTheory publishes no public developer API surface today; its api.welltheory.com backend and docs are private/internal.

providers.name: Pendulum
providers.description: Pendulum (Pendulum Therapeutics, pendulumlife.com) is a microbiome-management and metabolic-health company that develops clinically validated probiotic supplements built on novel, patented anaerobic microbial strains such as Akkermansia muciniphila. Its consumer products - including Glucose Control, Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, and a GLP-1 probiotic - are formulated to fuel and maintain the gut lining, support immunity, relieve gas and bloating, and help keep blood glucose in a healthy range, differentiated by double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials rather than off-the-shelf probiotic blends. Pendulum is a direct-to-consumer health and supplement brand and is a portfolio company of DCVC; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Pomelo Care
providers.description: Pomelo Care is a value-based virtual healthcare company delivering 24/7 clinician-led care for women and children across fertility and preconception, prenatal and postpartum, pediatric and NICU, and midlife and menopause health. Operating as a telehealth platform contracted with employers and health plans, Pomelo pairs licensed clinicians, doulas, and care teams with remote monitoring to close the gaps between doctor visits, reduce NICU admissions, and improve maternal and infant outcomes. The company reports covering 25 million lives across all 50 states and raised a $92M Series C at a $1.7B valuation. Pomelo Care is a patient-, employer-, and payer-facing platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and First Round Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Carta Healthcare
providers.description: Carta Healthcare, Inc. is a San Francisco based clinical data management company that applies a "Hybrid Intelligence" model — proprietary AI paired with certified human clinical abstractors — to extract, validate and submit structured clinical data on behalf of hospitals and health systems. Its product family covers Voyager (the underlying AI data platform trained on electronic medical record content), Lighthouse and Atlas (AI-assisted clinical registry abstraction and submission, including the ACC NCDR, STS/ACC TVT and Vascular Quality Initiative registries), Navigator (clinical data intelligence and analytics), Harbor (cohort selection and clinical trial matching) and outsourced expert abstraction services. Carta Healthcare is an NCDR certified software vendor and has completed a Type 2 SOC 2 examination with an unqualified opinion covering security, availability and confidentiality. The company sells and integrates directly with hospital EMR environments under enterprise agreements; it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract on its public web surface.

providers.name: Cerebral
providers.description: Cerebral is an American telehealth company providing online mental health and wellness care, including therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management delivered through its website and mobile app on a subscription basis. Founded in 2020 by Kyle Robertson and Ho Anh, the company treats conditions such as depression, anxiety, insomnia, ADHD, and substance use disorder. Cerebral is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, which led a $300M Series C in December 2021 valuing the company at roughly $4.8B. Cerebral is a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public company and website properties.

providers.name: Citruslabs
providers.description: Citruslabs is a clinical research organization (CRO) that designs and runs clinical trials, consumer perception studies, and randomized controlled trials for consumer health brands across supplements, skincare, pet health, food and beverage, longevity, and women's health. It handles IRB approval, protocol design, participant recruitment, decentralized data collection, and statistical analysis, then turns results into regulator-reviewed, marketing-ready product claims for retailers, advertising, and packaging. Studies range from DIY consumer perception studies to full randomized controlled trials, typically completing in four to sixteen weeks.

providers.name: Conceive
providers.description: Conceive is a telehealth platform for fertility and pregnancy support. It offers 24/7 text access to fertility and pregnancy nurses, coaches, and dietitians, personalized fertility coaching, fertility test interpretation, virtual video visits with providers, expert-led community events, and an educational library. Membership is delivered through Conceive Plus and Conceive Premium tiers. The company is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. As a consumer telehealth app it publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its published identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Dawaai
providers.description: Dawaai is Pakistan's leading digital healthcare platform, operating a licensed online pharmacy alongside telehealth and diagnostic services. Founded on a licensed retail pharmacy (License #1265, 2014) and headquartered in Karachi, Dawaai lets patients order authentic prescription and OTC medicines for temperature-controlled doorstep delivery, book doctor and mental-health consultations, order home-based lab tests and checkups, arrange home nursing and medical services, and subscribe to chronic-care programs for diabetes and obesity. It is a LegitScript-certified healthcare merchant that sources directly from manufacturers and distributors, with qualified pharmacists handling procurement, storage, and dispensing. Dawaai is backed by 500 Global and operates across Pakistan, including Karachi and Rawalpindi. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via the venture portfolio pipeline; Dawaai publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Dawn
providers.description: Dawn (Sleepedy, Inc. dba Dawn) is a digital-health company offering a clinician-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) program delivered through a mobile app. The service pairs users with licensed sleep coaches and therapists for weekly video sessions and between-session chat, daily 5-7 minute sleep lessons, live sleep-performance insights, and weekly progress reports, with the goal of treating primary and chronic insomnia and reducing reliance on sleep medication. Dawn is in-network with major U.S. insurers (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, United Healthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and offers an employer/enterprise workplace-wellness program. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Dawn publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Ezra
providers.description: Ezra (Ezra AI, Inc.) is a preventive-health company offering full-body MRI and CT cancer-screening scans directly to consumers. Its screening service scans up to 13 organs in as little as 22 minutes to detect early signs of cancer and hundreds of other conditions without harmful radiation, with plans spanning a full-body MRI, MRI with spine, a comprehensive skeletal/neurological MRI, and heart and lung CT scans, plus couples pricing and locations across the United States. Ezra was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp; this profile is a consumer healthcare company with no public developer API, and was enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline against its public web surface.

providers.name: Fightcamp
providers.description: FightCamp is a consumer connected-fitness company that sells an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system combining physical equipment (a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and Bluetooth motion-tracking punch trackers) with a subscription app of on-demand classes led by professional fighters. The trackers use motion sensors and AI to measure punch output, speed, and workout stats, syncing to a member app and customer dashboard for progress tracking. FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer hardware-plus-membership business (backed by IVP) and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, commerce, support, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Frontera
providers.description: Frontera (Frontera Health) is an AI-assisted clinical documentation company for behavioral health. Its software automates assessment and diagnosis report writing for Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and clinical psychologists working in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and autism care, cutting report time from 6-10 hours to 2-3 hours. The platform pairs a BCBA-trained AI Assessment Builder and Diagnosis Builder with digital phenotyping, and is delivered as a HIPAA-compliant web application (customer login at portal.fronterahealth.com) rather than a public API. Frontera is a venture-backed portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and security surface; as of this pass Frontera publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Heartbeat Health
providers.description: Heartbeat Health is a New York-based modern cardiology practice delivering remote and virtual cardiovascular care. The company combines early detection, home-based cardiac diagnostics, remote patient monitoring, risk stratification and evidence-based care coordination to proactively identify, treat and manage moderate-to-high cardiovascular risk. It serves hospitals and health systems, payors and employer groups, providers and ACOs, and in-home care providers, reporting outcomes such as 90%+ of patients reaching target blood pressure and a 53% reduction in cardiac readmissions. Backed by Optum Ventures, DaVita Venture Group and Echo Health Ventures, it is a care-delivery organization rather than a public API provider; no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Impress
providers.description: Impress (legal entity Smile2Impress SL) is a Barcelona-founded chain of clear-aligner orthodontic clinics, launched in 2019 by Vladimir Lupenko, Diliara Lupenko and Dr. Khaled Kasem, and today Europe's largest invisible-orthodontics clinic network. It runs 110+ doctor-led clinics across ten countries — Spain, Italy, Portugal, France, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, Ukraine and the United States — has treated more than 500,000 patients, and pairs in-clinic 3D intraoral scanning and patented diagnostics with AI-assisted treatment planning and remote monitoring through its patient mobile app. Impress publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, CLI, status page, changelog or machine-readable specification of any kind: contract discovery found no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, MCP server, A2A agent card or .well-known document on any host it operates. Its one API host, api.smile2impress.com, is the private backend for the Impress patient app and the Impress Clinics practitioner app; it resolves and is live but answers HTTP 403 to every anonymous request, including every spec and .well-known path probed. Its GitHub organization, github.com/smile2impress, is real but carries only internal engineering tooling — five forks of Node.js/TypeScript infrastructure libraries and one first-party static-analysis tool, fe-explorer — and no client library for any Impress service. Products sold are orthodontic treatment, retainers and teeth whitening, priced and booked through the consumer site.

providers.name: joinzoe
providers.description: JoinZoe (operating as ZOE) is a gut‑health science company that translates world‑leading research into everyday nutrition products and services. It runs the world’s largest gut‑health and nutrition study, amassing a database of over 300,000 DNA‑sequenced gut samples. Through its app, supplements, food products, and scientific podcasts, ZOE aims to improve the health of millions by providing personalized nutrition advice based on cutting‑edge microbiome science.

providers.name: Mindbloom
providers.description: Mindbloom is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering at-home ketamine-assisted therapy for anxiety, depression, and PTSD, combining psychiatric clinician oversight, guided therapeutic sessions, and peer support. Clients complete a psychiatric evaluation, receive either sublingual tablets or subcutaneous injectable treatments, and are supported through a structured program with monitoring and integration guidance. The company reports having facilitated over 200,000 ketamine therapy sessions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, or developer documentation — Mindbloom is a consumer healthcare service, not an API provider.

providers.name: Modern Fertility
providers.description: Modern Fertility is a women's health company offering at-home fertility and hormone testing along with pregnancy, ovulation and prenatal products. Its flagship Modern Fertility Hormone Test lets people measure reproductive hormones from home and review results with providers. The company was acquired by telehealth provider Ro and is now operated as part of Ro: modernfertility.com redirects to ro.co/fertility and the brand's products, accounts, legal terms and security program are served under the parent Ro platform. Modern Fertility exposes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks it as a consumer health brand within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: myLaurel
providers.description: myLaurel is a New York-based healthcare company delivering acute and transitional care in patients' homes. Its hybrid model pairs hands-on clinical teams with virtual technology support to prevent unnecessary hospitalizations, free critical hospital bed space, improve patient outcomes, and lower the total cost of care for both health systems and health plans. Reported results include a 49% reduction in 30-day readmissions, an average 1.5-day length-of-stay reduction, a 97 Net Promoter Score, and 3:1+ ROI within 90 days. myLaurel is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This profile has been enriched from the company's public web surface; it currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Petsapp
providers.description: PetsApp is a veterinary client engagement and practice communication platform used by more than 1,000 veterinary practices worldwide, with millions of pets registered and millions of dollars in payments processed. It gives clinics two-way SMS and in-app messaging, appointment booking, video consultations, digital payments, wellness and health-care plan management, automated reminders, and a lightweight CRM for building client relationships. PetsApp does not publish a public developer portal or open API; API access and documentation are offered privately to technology and PIMS integration partners through its partner program, and its public docs subdomain is a Jira Service Management customer help center rather than API reference documentation.

providers.name: Pharmeasy
providers.description: PharmEasy is one of India's largest digital healthcare platforms, operating a consumer online pharmacy and health marketplace at pharmeasy.in. It lets users order prescription and over-the-counter medicines (with prescription upload and verification), buy health and wellness products, book diagnostic lab tests and health checkup packages, and consult doctors via telemedicine, plus a PLUS subscription for recurring savings. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.
